title.text: Meliá Desert Palm, member of Meliá Collection

pills.label: In 15:00, out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00. Bring photo ID and a credit card: an AED 1,000 (about €247) refundable deposit is taken by card on arrival.

pills.label: 198 m² pool villa
pills.pop_html: Your villa: The One-Bedroom Villa with Private Pool is 2,131 ft² (about 198 m²), with a separate living room, one bathroom and an extra-large double bed. At about €2.40 per m², that is the most space for your money on this page.

pills.label: No cots or extra beds
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Children of any age are welcome, but there are no cots or extra beds, so the one-bedroom villa is really for two. Minimum check-in age 18; the resort is wheelchair accessible.

pills.label: Own pool + infinity pool
pills.pop_html: Pools: Your villa has its own pool, and the resort adds an outdoor infinity pool. Villas also offer in-villa spa treatments and an in-villa BBQ with a personal chef on request.

pills.label: 160-acre polo estate
pills.pop_html: Setting: A championship polo field, polo and riding lessons (book ahead), tennis and a jogging and cycling track, with views of Burj Khalifa and the skyline from the restaurants.

pills.label: SAMĀNA Spa
pills.pop_html: Spa: A water circuit with steam room, sauna, ice room, cold pool and heated stone beds, plus couples' treatment suites and a Thai massage suite.

pills.label: Quiet country estate
pills.pop_html: The vibe: Green lawns, horses and art from the owner's private collection, 20 minutes from Dubai Mall. Staff score 9.6 and cleanliness 9.5.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want a big villa with its own pool, a serious spa and green polo fields for under €500 a night at the member price, 15 minutes from the airport.
best_for.skip_html: if you want sand and sea: this is an inland estate, so book Nikki Beach (#4) or One&Only The Palm (#3) instead.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: From 15:00, check-out until 12:00. Photo ID, credit card and an AED 1,000 refundable deposit.
Not shown as included in the €481 villa rate; guests rate breakfast exceptional.
Private villa pool plus the resort's outdoor infinity pool.
One-Bedroom Villa with Private Pool, 2,131 ft² (about 198 m²), living room, extra-large double bed.
SAMĀNA Spa: steam room, sauna, ice room, cold pool, heated stone beds, couples' suites.

pills.label: In 15:00, out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00 to 18:00 and check-out from 08:00 to 12:00. An AED 1,000 (about €247) refundable deposit is taken by card on arrival.

pills.label: 97 m² suite with pool
pills.pop_html: Your suite: The 1 Bedroom Skyline Suite with Pool is a 1,044 ft² (about 97 m²) apartment-style suite with one bedroom, a living room, a kitchen and an extra-large double bed. The listing names a pool with the suite but does not say it is private, so ask the hotel before booking.

pills.label: Accessible rooms
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Children are welcome and pay as adults from 13; extra beds for ages 6+ cost AED 200 a night. Wheelchair accessible with grab rails, a raised toilet and a lower sink. Check-in age 18+.

pills.label: Infinity + plunge pools
pills.pop_html: Pools: Besides the pool that comes with the suite, the hotel has a year-round outdoor infinity pool with a pool bar, a plunge pool and a shallow end, and a hot tub.

pills.label: 1.2 km to Marina Beach
pills.pop_html: Beach: On JBR's Beach Walk, 1.2 km (a 14-minute walk) from Marina Beach, with Dubai Marina on your doorstep. Location scores 9.6, the best on this page.

pills.label: Very good breakfast
pills.pop_html: Dining: Continental, full English, Asian and American breakfasts; French, American, Japanese and Mediterranean cooking later, plus a bar and coffee shop.

pills.label: Sea-view city resort
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A big, polished resort with sea views and balconies, in the middle of the JBR and Marina scene. The most-reviewed hotel on this page: 11,584 reviews at 9.4.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want a suite with a pool, a kitchen and Dubai Marina nightlife at JBR for €440, with free cancellation on the suite rate.
best_for.skip_html: if you want to step from your room onto the sand: Marina Beach is 1.2 km away, so book Nikki Beach (#4) instead.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: 15:00–18:00, check-out 08:00–12:00. AED 1,000 refundable deposit.
Continental, full English, Asian and American; rated very good by guests.
Marina Beach 1.2 km, about a 14-minute walk.
Suite listed with a pool (private not stated) plus outdoor infinity pool with pool bar, plunge pool and hot tub.
1 Bedroom Skyline Suite with Pool, 1,044 ft² (about 97 m²), living room, kitchen.

price.note: Cheapest room or villa sold with a pool, for 2 adults on 13–14 January 2027. Dates, unit type and board change it; taxes and the Dubai tourism fee are added at booking.

pills.label: In 15:00, out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00 to midnight, check-out until 12:00. Photo ID and a credit card at check-in; cash is not accepted.

pills.label: 120 m² beachfront suite
pills.pop_html: Your suite: The Beachfront Junior Suite with Pool is 1,292 ft² (about 120 m²), with a private pool, a sea-view balcony and a bathroom with a bath. The rate includes waterpark access.

pills.label: Check-in age 21
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Children are welcome and pay as adults from 12; cots are free for under-4s and extra beds for 4–16 cost AED 250 a night. The strictest check-in age here: 21. Wheelchair accessible.

pills.label: Breakfast included
pills.pop_html: Rate: The €3,259 pool-suite rate includes breakfast, free cancellation and nothing to pay until you arrive.

pills.label: Private sandy beach
pills.pop_html: Beach: A private beach on the Palm, gardens, Andalusian architecture and three pools, including an infinity pool with a pool bar.

pills.label: Two-Michelin-star STAY
pills.pop_html: Dining: Yannick Alléno runs the kitchens: French at STAY, Mediterranean seafood at 101, breakfasts and Italian at ZEST.

pills.label: Boutique and romantic
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A small, secluded resort for couples, with comfort scored 9.7 and staff 9.6; only Al Marmoom's 9.8 is higher here.

best_for.pick_html: for a once-in-a-lifetime couple's trip: a beachfront suite with its own pool, breakfast and two-Michelin-star dining on the Palm.
best_for.skip_html: if €3,259 a night is more than you want to spend: Nikki Beach (#4) gives you a beach villa with private pool and breakfast for €1,036.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: From 15:00 to midnight, check-out until 12:00. Photo ID and credit card.
Included in the €3,259 pool-suite rate.
Private sandy beach on the resort.
Private suite pool plus 3 resort pools incl. infinity pool with pool bar.
Beachfront Junior Suite with Pool, 1,292 ft² (about 120 m²), sea-view balcony; Executive Suite with Pool 1,615 ft².

pills.label: In 15:00, out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00. Minimum check-in age 18.

pills.label: 118 m² pool villa
pills.pop_html: Your villa: The One-Bedroom Villa with Private Pool is 1,270 ft² (about 118 m²), with one bedroom, two bathrooms and an extra-large double bed. Breakfast is included at €1,036.

pills.label: Free cots and beds under 6
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Cots are free for under-4s and extra beds free for ages 4–5; AED 150 a night for 6–12 and AED 300 for 13+. There is a Kids' Playroom.

pills.label: 450 m private beach
pills.pop_html: Beach: A 450 m private beach facing the Gulf on Pearl Jumeira island, with free access to the outdoor pools and the Nikki Beach Club.

pills.label: 5 restaurants
pills.pop_html: Dining: Soul Lounge, Café Nikki, Bungalo34, the Beach Club restaurant and seasonal Maison Mer, with produce from an on-site hydroponic farm.

pills.label: 15 min to DXB
pills.pop_html: Location: Close to Dubai Mall and Downtown and 15 minutes from Dubai International, far closer to the city than the Palm resorts.

pills.label: Beach-club glamour
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A beach-club resort with a Nikki Beach playlist in every room and weekly beach yoga and fitness events in season. Guest score 9.1.

best_for.pick_html: for couples who want a villa with its own pool steps from a private beach, breakfast included, at a third of One&Only's price.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a secluded hideaway: the Nikki Beach Club is part of the resort. One&Only (#3) or Meliá (#1) are quieter picks.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: From 15:00, check-out until 12:00.
Included in the €1,036 villa rate.

pills.label: In 14:00, out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 14:00, one of the earliest here, and check-out from 11:30 to 12:00. Photo ID, credit card and an AED 500 (about €123) refundable deposit.

pills.label: Suite with private pool
pills.pop_html: Your suite: The Suite with Private Pool has an extra-large double bed and creek and city views, and the rate comes with 25% off food and drink in the hotel.

pills.label: Free cots
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Cots are free for under-3s; extra beds cost AED 120 a night and children pay as adults from 12. Wheelchair accessible; check-in age 18+.

pills.label: Breakfast €32
pills.pop_html: Breakfast: Breakfast is €32 extra where it is not included; guests rate it good.

pills.label: 5 creekside venues
pills.pop_html: Dining: Morgan's gastropub, Gusto Italian, Salt & Pepper, Vanilla Lobby Lounge and The Deck Pool Lounge, all with terraces over Dubai Creek.

pills.label: Minutes from DXB
pills.pop_html: Location: On the edge of Dubai Creek, minutes by road from Dubai International, Dubai World Trade Centre, the souks and the Creek Golf & Yacht Club.

pills.label: Old-Dubai waterfront
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A modern business-and-leisure hotel in the city's original heartland, with a rooftop pool and pool bar. Value scored 8.7.

best_for.pick_html: for anyone who wants a hotel suite with its own pool at the lowest price here, €429, minutes from the airport for a stopover or short break.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a beach or the newer Dubai skyline on your doorstep: the Creek is old Dubai, far from the coast. FIVE LUXE (#2) costs €11 more at JBR.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: From 14:00, check-out 11:30–12:00. AED 500 refundable deposit.

pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00. Photo ID and a credit card at check-in; tell the hotel your arrival time.

pills.label: 235 m² Royal Suite
pills.pop_html: Your suite: The Anantara Royal Suite with Pool is 2,530 ft² (about 235 m²) on the top floors: master bedroom with a study, living room, dining room and a fully equipped kitchenette.

pills.label: Extra beds AED 100
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Children are welcome and pay as adults from 12; extra beds for 11+ cost AED 100 a night, but there are no cots. Wheelchair accessible; check-in age 18+.

pills.label: Balcony plunge pool
pills.pop_html: Pool: The living room opens onto a balcony with a private plunge pool. Downstairs there is a heated rooftop pool with a shallow end and pool bar.

pills.label: Minutes from Dubai Mall
pills.pop_html: Location: On Downtown Burj Khalifa Street in Business Bay, minutes from Dubai Mall and DIFC; Dubai International is 18 km away.

pills.label: Free cancellation
pills.pop_html: Rate: The €1,076 Royal Suite rate came with free cancellation, at 40% off the hotel's standard price for the night.

pills.label: Skyline penthouse
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A sleek city hotel with floor-to-ceiling windows and sweeping skyline views; comfort scores 9.4.

best_for.pick_html: for a city break with a top-floor suite, a plunge pool on your balcony and Dubai Mall minutes away, with free cancellation.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a full-size pool to swim in: a balcony plunge pool is for cooling off. Meliá (#1) has a proper villa pool for €481 (member price).

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?

pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00, check-out until 12:00, with two-way airport transfers included on the villa rate. No minimum check-in age.

pills.label: 130 m² Al Bahar Villa
pills.pop_html: Your villa: The One Bedroom Al Bahar Villa with Private Pool is 1,399 ft² (about 130 m²), with a living room, an extra-large double bed and a sofa bed.

pills.label: Kids' club + Wild Wadi
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: No age limits, free cots, extra beds AED 200 a night for under-18s, a kids' club and a kids' pool. The villa rate includes daily Wild Wadi Water Park access. Wheelchair accessible.

pills.label: Breakfast + dinner
pills.pop_html: What's included: Breakfast in the villa, dinner, afternoon tea, evening drinks and canapés, butler service and airport transfers, with free cancellation.

pills.label: Private beach area
pills.pop_html: Beach: A private beach area by the resort, Jumeira Public Beach a six-minute walk away, and four pools including a kids' pool.

pills.label: Spa and yoga
pills.pop_html: Wellness: A spa with sauna and hot tub, wellness packages, a fitness centre and yoga classes.

pills.label: Classic family resort
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A classic beachfront family resort with sea and landmark views and a 9.5 location score, the joint second-best here.

best_for.pick_html: for families or couples who want a private-pool villa where almost everything is included: two meals, butler, transfers and daily Wild Wadi.
best_for.skip_html: if you are two adults who will eat out: you pay €2,107 for inclusions you may not use. Nikki Beach (#4) is €1,071 cheaper.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.a: From 15:00, check-out until 12:00. Two-way airport transfers included on the villa rate.

pills.label: In 15:00, out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 15:00 to 23:30, check-out from 12:00 to 12:30, with private check-in. Tell the lodge your arrival time in advance.

pills.label: 62 m² dome
pills.pop_html: Your dome: The Dome is 667 ft² (about 62 m²) with a double bed, a sofa bed, a bathroom with a bath and walk-in shower, a private entrance and a terrace with lake views.

pills.label: Free extra beds 4–11
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: No minimum check-in age, free cots for under-4s and free extra beds for ages 4–11; children pay as adults from 13. Indoor and outdoor play areas and family rooms.

pills.label: Private pool
pills.pop_html: Pool: The dome is listed with a private pool, with lake, garden and pool views.

pills.label: Breakfast included
pills.pop_html: Rate: The €837 dome rate includes breakfast, which guests rate exceptional, and free cancellation. Half-board, full-board and all-inclusive versions are also sold.

pills.label: Horse riding nearby
pills.pop_html: Activities: Horse riding nearby, with outdoor fireplace, barbecue facilities and a sun terrace at the lodge. Location 9.5, comfort and staff 9.8.

pills.label: Off-grid desert dome
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A small lodge out in the Al Marmoom desert reserve, about 25 miles from the centre: quiet nights and big skies.

best_for.pick_html: for couples or small families who want a night in the Al Marmoom reserve in a dome with its own pool and breakfast, instead of a resort tower.
best_for.skip_html: if you want the beach or city in the same trip: the lodge is 25 miles out. Pair a night here with a city hotel instead of a full stay.

title.text: Al Bandar Arjaan by Rotana, Dubai Creek

pills.label: In 14:00, out 12:00
pills.pop_html: Check-in and out: Check-in from 14:00, check-out until 12:00. Photo ID and a credit card at check-in; minimum check-in age 18.

pills.label: 90 m² 1-bed apartment
pills.pop_html: Your apartment: The One Bedroom Apartment with Private Pool is 969 ft² (about 90 m²) with a kitchen, one bathroom and an extra-large double bed.

pills.label: Free cots
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Free cots for under-3s; extra beds for 12+ cost AED 120 a night. Wheelchair accessible, with an emergency cord in the bathroom.

pills.label: Breakfast included
pills.pop_html: Rate: The €456 pool-apartment rate includes breakfast, which guests rate superb, and 25% off food and drink. Breakfast is €32 on rates without it.

pills.label: Shares the Rotana's venues
pills.pop_html: Dining: Connected to the five-star Al Bandar Rotana, so you get its five venues, including Morgan's gastropub and Gusto Italian, plus in-room dining.

pills.label: Rooftop pool too
pills.pop_html: Pools: Besides the apartment's own pool, there is a rooftop pool with a pool bar and the Bodylines gym, sauna and steam rooms.

pills.label: Home-style creekside
pills.pop_html: The vibe: A calm hotel-apartment block on Dubai Creek built for long-stay visitors, minutes by road from Dubai International.

best_for.pick_html: for longer stays or self-caterers: a 90 m² apartment with a kitchen, its own pool and breakfast included for €456.
best_for.skip_html: if you want a beach or a buzzing area: this is a quiet creekside base. FIVE LUXE (#2) at JBR is €16 cheaper.

items.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?

pills.label: 461 m² 4-bed villa
pills.pop_html: Your villa: The Four Bedroom Royal Lagoon Pool access Villa is 4,962 ft² (about 461 m²) with four bedrooms, four bathrooms, a kitchen and five beds.

pills.label: Kids' and teens' club
pills.pop_html: Kids and access: Free cots for under-4s, extra beds AED 250 a night from age 3, and a kids' and teens' club. Wheelchair accessible; check-in age 18+.

pills.label: Royal Villa pools
pills.pop_html: Pool: The 38 Royal Villas come with private pools and 24-hour butler service, and you have direct access to the resort pool and private beach.

pills.label: In-villa breakfast
pills.pop_html: Rate: Daily in-villa breakfast, butler service and a complimentary soft-drinks minibar, with free cancellation and nothing to pay until arrival.

pills.label: Pets allowed
pills.pop_html: Pets: The only property on this page that accepts pets; charges may apply, and pet baskets and bowls are provided.

pills.label: Ottoman palace
pills.pop_html: The vibe: Grand Ottoman-inspired architecture on the Palm's West Crescent and the 8,200 m² Talise Ottoman Spa. Parts of the resort are under renovation; the Royal Villas stay open.

best_for.pick_html: for families or groups who want a four-bedroom Palm villa with pool access, a butler and the beach, at about €465 per bedroom.
best_for.skip_html: if you are a couple: you pay for four bedrooms. One&Only (#3) or Nikki Beach (#4) suit two people better.
